Leverandøren skal påta seg et totalansvar for å levere (utforme, prosjektere, bygge og leie ut), samt forvalte, drifte og vedlikeholde sykehjemmet.Konkurransen er reservert for ideelle organisasjoner, jf. anskaffelsesforskriften § 30-2a.Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det i kunngjøringsskjemaet er opplyst at det er en åpen anbudskonkurranse. Dette er fordi det per i dag ikke er teknisk mulig å velge prosedyren "åpen tilbudskonkurranse" i kunngjøringsskjemaet når skjema eForm 20 Helse- og sosialtjenester benyttes. Vi understreker imidlertid at prosedyren som skal benyttes er "åpen tilbudskonkurranse".

buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
title: Ireland – Landscape architectural services – Garden Design for Knockreer Gardens Killarney National Park
description: Tenders are being sought for the preparation of a Conservation Design and Development Plan (CDDP) focused on the long-term practice of conservation horticulture at Knockreer House Gardens (set out in 2.3). The Gardens are managed by the National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) an Executive Agency within the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. The Knockreer House Gardens are authentically unique, in that they have evolved their own character and style. Within this context, the CDDP will be guided by best international practice in conservation design and interpretation.

buyer: De Werkvennootschap NV van publiek recht
title: Belgium – Construction work – DBFM Contract relating to the comprehensive renovation of the Rupel Tunnel
description: The DBFM Contract relating to the comprehensive renovation of the Rupel Tunnel is part of the Flanders Tunnel Plan. As part of the Flanders Tunnel Plan, the Agency for Roads and Traffic has developed a master plan aimed at ensuring the safety and reliability of all tunnels in Flanders over a ten-year period, modernising their operation and introducing professional asset management in accordance with ISO 55001. Comprehensive renovations constitute one of the four pillars of the Flanders Tunnel Plan. A comprehensive renovation, including the comprehensive renovation of the Rupel Tunnel, combines all structural and civil engineering works with the renewal of technical installations designed to enhance safety. For the purposes of the present procurement procedure, the Agency for Roads and Traffic and De Werkvennootschap have entered into a cooperation arrangement under which De Werkvennootschap makes its knowledge and expertise available to the Agency for Roads and Traffic. In this context, De Werkvennootschap has been authorised to conduct the present Procurement Procedure in the name and on behalf of the Agency for Roads and Traffic. For the purposes of awarding the Contract, the Agency for Roads and Traffic will be represented by De Werkvennootschap, which will act vis-à-vis third parties as the Agency’s authorised representative and as the central and sole point of contact, unless expressly stated otherwise.

title: Netherlands – Planning systems – IvhO-EURAAN-JP-IUCN2607001 Aanschaf, installatie en configuratie plannings- en capaciteitstool
description: De Staat der Nederlanden nodigt u als potentiële Inschrijver uit om in te schrijven voor de Europese Aanbesteding Aanschaf, installatie en configuratie plannings- en capaciteitstool. Doel is het afsluiten van een contract met één geselecteerde leverancier die na gunning (medio mei 2027) start met de vervanging van de huidige planningstool in Excel. Wij zoeken hiervoor een on-premise oplossing. De totale geschatte opdrachtwaarde voor 4 jaar bedraagt €1.200.000,- exclusief btw, zegge één miljoen tweehonderdduizend euro exclusief btw. De IvhO voorziet in de optiejaren een verdere doorontwikkeling van de gecontracteerde oplossing, de totaal geschatte opdrachtwaarde voor de komende jaren calculeren wij op €2.225.000,- exclusief btw, zegge twee miljoen tweehonderdvijfentwintigduizend euro exclusief btw. Let op: de gegevens die de omvang van de opdracht aangeven zijn een indicatie op basis vanuit het verleden en voor de komende jaren. Aan deze omvang kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

title: U2940 EFU-10988 Storetveit skole - anskaffelse av totalentreprenør
description: Bergen kommune, Etat for utbygging, innbyr med dette til konkurranse om kontrakt for totalentreprise i prosjektet U2940 Storetveit skole. Storetveit ungdomsskole har behov for oppgradering og utvidet kapasitet for å møte dagens pedagogiske og tekniske krav, i tillegg til forventet elevtallsøkning. Skolens elevkapasitet skal økes fra 450 til 600 elever. Eksisterende skolebygg skal rehabiliteres og bygges om. I tillegg skal to bygg rives, og det skal bygges ett nytt bygg inkl. idrettshall. Prosjektet innebærer også oppgradering av uteområder for både skolen og Storetveit barnehage, samt rekkefølgekrav knyttet til bl.a. trafikksikkerhet, oppgradering av veier, plasser og stier.

title: APN - NORAD Northern Basing Infrastructure (NNBI), Nunavut
description: Advance Procurement Notice NORAD Northern Basing Infrastructure (NNBI)  Forward Operating Location Iqaluit, Nunavut (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform Design-Builders of an upcoming contract opportunity at Forward Operating Location Iqaluit, Nunavut. The purpose of this APN is to allow Design-Builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested Design-Builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services The Department of National Defence (DND) is investing in infrastructure developments for the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD) Modernization and Continental Defence at the Forward Operating Location Iqaluit, Nunavut.  This infrastructure investment aims to ensure that the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) have the tools they need to achieve their security and sovereignty objectives. These improvements will enable advanced aircraft operations and quick mobilization in the North for NORAD missions.   The infrastructure requirements for the FOL Iqaluit will include the following but are not limited to:  Airfield improvements;   Hangars with aprons and taxiways;   Ammunition compounds;  Fuel facilities;   Accommodations, warehousing, planning, multi-purpose facilities, and support equipment;   Robust IT, Cyber, and Logistics infrastructure.     Preliminary rough order of magnitude (ROM) estimates for the various facility components for each locations are as follows, subject to revision: Total hangar space, ~ 7,500 m2 Fuel storage, between 500,000 and 750,000 litres Office space  500 m2 Ammunition Storage 600 m2 Accommodations 4,000 m2 Fire Hall 2,000 m2 Multi-purpose facilities 9,000 m2 Indoor storage (Total), 7,000 m2 Apron 60,000 m2 Total asphalt surface 72,000 m2 The delivery method for this infrastructure will be a Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract, with one MDB contract for the site and an estimated total contract value that may exceed $5B. This multi-year contract consists of the following sequential and/or concurrent phases and are not limited to:  Requirements validation, concept development, market analysis and planning activities.   Design Phase activities.  Construction Phase activities.   It is anticipated that the Request for Proposal (RFP) will include detailed evaluation criteria; however, these remain subject to change and will be finalized and fully described in the RFP documentation upon release. At a high level, it is expected that the RFP will assess proponents on demonstrated experience across a range of factors, including northern design and construction experience, experience delivering similar asset types (both within and outside of northern environments), and the integration of design and construction capabilities within a single team. Key personnel requirements will include demonstrated northern experience for certain roles. The evaluation of approach and methodology is expected to consider how proponents plan to successfully deliver projects in northern environments, including logistics, climate, and constructability considerations, as well as their approach to Indigenous participation based on principles of meaningful participation and mitigation of potential adverse effects. In addition to the technical evaluation, a formal interview process will be conducted to further assess team capability to successfully deliver the project in a northern environment. The terms and conditions of the contract will allow for self-performed work by the design-build team.    The MDB solicitation for Iqaluit is projected to be released in Fall 2027. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by DND.   The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In support of these commitments, DND aims to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through meaningful subcontracting, employment, and training related to the proposed project.  To align with these objectives, the successful proponents will be required to develop an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) as part of the MDB contract. The IBP will outline proposed initiatives and opportunities for Indigenous participation, including subcontracting, employment, and training activities.  Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a Design-Builder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Facility Security Clearance at the level of SECRET. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing Design-Builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, Design-Builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 87007; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the Design-Builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a Design-Builder: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the

title: ITS4US Deployment Accelerator
description: The Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) looks to accelerate the replication of innovative technology solutions developed by large-scale deployment projects that it sponsors. ITS JPO believes that successful demonstration of these solutions by multiple agencies validates the technology's maturity and readiness for broader implementation across the industry. The purpose of this Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) is to award up to five (5) operational pilots that will test integrated technology solutions developed and deployed by the ITS4US Deployment Program. Each awardee will develop, test, and deploy solutions modeled on ITS4US deployment project documentation and its associated open-source software. In addition, the awardees will form a deployer cohort where they receive USDOT-funded technical support designed to accelerate implementation. Awardees can build faster, better, and cheaper by launching related efforts together, and use the insight of peers who have recently succeeded in addressing similar challenges. See Attachments for further information.

description: July 7, 2026: This is Amendment 0009 to solicitation 47QRCA23R0001 The General Services Administration (GSA), Federal Acquisition Service (FAS), Office of Acquisition Solutions Development (ASD), is issuing Amendment 0009 in accordance with RFO-2025-05 Supplement 1 FAR 5.101 for the One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+), Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ), Multi-Agency Contracts (MAC). The System for Award Management (SAM.gov) is the official source for information about this procurement. The following documents and attachments are updated as a result of Amendment 0009: OASIS+ Small Business RFP (current as of Amendment 0009) SF30 (Amendment 0009) and Continuation Sheet Provisional Attachments J.P-1 OASIS+ Domain Qualifications Matrix and Scorecards J.P-2 FPDS Sample J.P-3 Project Verification Form J.P-4 Domains Auto-Relevant NAICS Codes and PSCs J.P-9 Cost/Price Template J.P-14 Lateral Springboarding Summary Sheet Contract Attachments J-2 Task Order, Transactional Data, and Contract Access Fee Reporting J-4 Department of Defense Required Provisions and Clauses for Task Orders J-5 Task Order Clause and Provision Matrix Consistent with Section H.11 of the OASIS+ RFP, GSA intends to maintain continuously open solicitations to support rolling admissions/on-ramping and to allow existing awardees, when eligible, to compete for additional Domains as Government needs evolve. Should GSA determine a need to close any domain or solicitation, the agency will provide public notification. Offerors are permitted to submit a single proposal for multiple domains under a single solicitation. There is no fixed timeline for award; timelines will vary based on the volume of proposals received and are subject to resource availability. Offerors must be registered and active in SAM.gov. All proposals must be submitted through the OASIS+ SubmissionPortal (OSP). The OSP is open for registration and submission of offers as of January 12, 2026. Registration information and submission instructions are provided at https://oasis.app.cloud.gov/. For questions related to registration or technical issues, offerors can contact client.support@apexlogic.com. Industry is instructed to review the solicitation requirements and all amendments before submitting an offer. Offerors submitting a new offer after issuance of Amendment 0009 must acknowledge all current amendments in the OSP by completing the required amendment acknowledgement action during offer submission. A signed SF 33 remains required as part of all offer submissions; however, a separate signed SF30 upload is not required for new offers submitted after issuance of Amendment 0009 unless otherwise directed by the Government. Offerors that submitted an offer prior to issuance of Amendment 0009 and who have not received a contract award or unsuccessful notice are required to acknowledge Amendment 0009 by signing this SF 30 and uploading the signed SF 30 in Symphony to the Business Factors section for the applicable RFP no later than July 15, 2026. Offerors with pending offers under more than one OASIS+ RFP must upload the signed SF30 to the Business Factors section of each applicable RFP for which acknowledgement is required. Offerors are responsible for ensuring that the signed SF30 uploaded for each pending offer corresponds to the correct OASIS+ RFP. Please follow the steps below to upload the signed SF 30 in Symphony: Login to Symphony at https://oasis.app.cloud.gov/. Navigate to My Company. Navigate to the Business Factors page. Ensure the "My Solicitation Preferences" field is set to any OASIS+ solicitation to display the appropriate factors. Scroll down to the Other Documents section to see the Amendment 9 SF30 factor for each solicitation. Click the Amendment 9 factor for solicitations submitted prior to Amendment 9 release (Example: "Amendment 9 SF30 - OASIS+ 8(a) Continuously Open"). Upload the signed SF30 document and select the checkbox to certify the claim for the factor. Click "Save and Claim" for the factor. The signed SF30 is required for amendment acknowledgement purposes only. Offerors shall not submit revised proposal documents, additional supporting documentation, or other proposal changes. Failure to submit the signed SF30 by the stated deadline may result in the offer being ineligible for further consideration. Offerors are solely responsible for reviewing and staying current with the solicitation and all amendments posted on SAM.gov. In the event of a conflict, the solicitation and amendments posted to this notice on SAM.gov take precedence over any information contained on other websites or prior communications. title: AS25 Lugano-Melide, binari di giro corsa Parte 2: FASE 1 + FASE 2 - Opere da impresario costruttore
description:
Le présent contrat a pour objet l’exécution des prestations nécessaires à la réalisation des travaux d’agrandissement, d’adaptation et de modernisation de la gare ferroviaire de Melide, dans le cadre du projet Partie 2 – Phases 1 et 2.

Les travaux comprennent principalement la réalisation et l’adaptation des voies de circulation, de garage et de rebroussement, la construction et l’adaptation des quais ainsi que des infrastructures d’accès conformément à la législation sur l’accessibilité des personnes en situation de handicap, ainsi que l’exécution des ouvrages de génie civil, ferroviaires, techniques et accessoires nécessaires pour garantir l’exploitation du trafic voyageurs longue distance, le garage et la gestion des convois, l’adaptation des infrastructures existantes et le plein respect des dispositions techniques et réglementaires en vigueur.

Sont également comprises les prestations relatives à l’adaptation du passage inférieur existant, du hall d’accès à la gare, des chemins de service ainsi que des autres infrastructures fonctionnellement liées au projet.
